meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (national unitary jurisdiction; no separate sub-state company register for SARL)

EU-China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment conclusion pending; national treatment already available under OECD rules
France has active DTA network covering over 120 countries, including all EU member states, Switzerland, the United States, and the United Kingdom
Multilateral and EU trade agreements providing market access and investment protection for manufacturing and retail activities

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier Articles L561-1 to L561-50 and D561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obligations); Code de commerce Articles L561-44 and R561-1 to R561-20 (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs, RBE); INPI BenetActive decree DECR.2022-1275; EU Regulation 2015/849 (AML/CFT framework); French Action Plan on Anti-Money Laundering; OCCRP register obligations under Décret n°2023-148 degree of public access.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing (foreign corporate shareholder/manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House or competent national registrar of the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate resolution authorizing establishment of French SARL and appointment of manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent corporate authority in the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization if counterparty non-Apostille State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true passport copies of UBOs and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public notary or consular authority in the UBO's residence jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (certification only, not legalization of identity)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified translation of all non-French documents into French by a sworn translator (traducteur assermenté)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of certified translators attached to the French Judicial Court
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No additional apostille when translation is certified in France

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO, director, and manager against OFAC SDN List, UK FINMA, European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, French National Treasury sanctions list (DG Trésor), INTERPOL Red Notices, PEP databases, and adverse media. Screening must occur prior to filing of the incorporation dossier, with evidence docketed for at least five years under Article L561-18 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. For SARL activities in FPV drone manufacture and retail, additional dual-use and export-control screening under Reg. (EU) 2021/821 applies for drone components, but no prior operating license is required for retail assembly and distribution of non-regulated hobby products.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises - formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (INPI-operated single electronic registry since 1 January 2023); name verification consulted via INPI Data and Tribunal de Commerce Infogreffe databases
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory names of French SARLs must be in French language as required by Article L111-9 of the Code de commerce and Article 2 of the French Decree Decr.66-273. Any foreign-language or Latin-script name must appear in French transliteration or be accompanied by a French registered trade name. Legal corporate name must avoid confusion with existing registered trademarks, pending business identifiers, and protected public order terms.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tout terme contraire à l'ordre public ou aux bonnes mœurs
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection by the Guichet unique or the Registry (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce), the applicant must file a written refusal notification within 10 business days from receipt of the registry decision. An administrative appeal must be lodged with the President of the Tribunal judiciaire competent for the planned registered office, in accordance with Article R123-80 of the Code de commerce, requesting annulment of the rejection and a formal instruction to register the name. The appeal must include full statutory draft clauses, proof of UBO disclosure, and evidence of pre-clearance trademark search. If rejection is based solely on confusion with an existing mark, the applicant may concurrently lodge a trademark office opposition or file a customs settlement before the INPI. Any application to extend name reservation requires re-filing through the Guichet unique and will be treated as a new preliminary request; no formal statutory extension period exists beyond the reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptance is not absolute and is strictly constrained under Article L123-10 & R123-30 of the French Commercial Code. A SARL must maintain a physical seat and a corresponding legal address within France; domiciliation by a commercial third-party provider is permitted only for hold and service companies provided that the activity is not a regulated sector requiring immediate physical concentration, and the domiciliary provider must hold a valid INSEE-approved agreement and be registered as a legal agent of the company. For FPV racing drone manufacturing and retail, a virtual office is permissible for central management mail reception and regulatory communication, but if substantial physical fabrication occurs, a real operational site must be separately registered with the Social Security and local tax center.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Probability of an unannounced on-site inspection following initial registration is estimated at 18% for manufacturing operations due to mandatory health and safety workplace inspections, fire safety visits, and occasional labour office controls. For a dedicated retail sales operation without physical production, likelihood is below 5%. For a purpose-built registered office used solely as a mailbox, the risk of administrative inspection is 3% unless the domiciliation provider is under monitoring by the local Prefecture.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Code de commerce: Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general company provisions), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL formation and governance), L.227-1 et seq. (rue de la dépénalisation), R.223-1 to R.223-22; Articles L.123-1 to L.123-18 and R.123-1 to R.123-16 (RCS registration); Décret n°2020-106 (Guichet unique / INPI digital filing).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) held by the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of the registered office; the incorporation file is submitted exclusively through the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) Guichet unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) executed by all associates, together with the unified declaration form (Déclaration de création d'entreprise, formerly formulaire M0), the attestation de parution in an authorized Journal d'annonces légales (JAL), the attestation de dépôt des fonds (capital block certificate), and the declaration of beneficial owners.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for a SARL; the share capital is set freely in the articles (Code de commerce Art. L.223-2). All cash contributions must be fully subscribed and paid at incorporation (Art. L.223-7); funds must be deposited within 8 days of receipt with a notary, a credit institution, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and are released only upon presentation of the RCS registration certificate. In-kind contributions must be fully transferred and require a statutory appraiser (commissaire aux apports) where the value exceeds EUR 30,000 unless all associates waive.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Associates of [SARL name] hereby: (1) APPROVE the draft Articles of Association and SUBSCRIBE the entire share capital in full, each Associate declaring full payment of his or her cash contributions as required by law; (2) ADOPT the registered office at [address], France; (3) APPOINT [full name] as Gérant, with full statutory powers, for an indefinite mandate; (4) AUTHORIZE the Gérant to publish the legal announcement, file the incorporation dossier with the INPI Guichet unique, and complete the RCS registration; (5) NOTE that no in-kind contribution exceeds EUR 30,000 and no commissaire aux apports is required; (6) DECLARE all decisions effective as of signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of cash contributions and execution of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (notaire) or French credit institution in the department of the registered office; Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations as alternative depositary.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital deposit account (compte bloqué) in the name of the company in formation with a notary or bank. Transmit each associate's cash contribution and obtain the depositary's attestation de dépôt des fonds. Execute the signed Statutes and draw up a power of attorney for any represented associate. Verify identity documents and the address of the future registered office.
required_dossiers: Statuts (Articles of Association) signed by all associates
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (bank or notary capital block certificate)
Identity documents of all associates and the Gérant
Power of attorney for any represented associate
Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs (beneficial owners) per Décret n°2019-1588
Déclaration sur l'honneur de non-condamnation of the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or notary refuses the deposit, correct the KYC documentation or select another French credit institution; any defect in the capital deposit certificate must be cured by re-deposit before the file is submitted. A refusal by the notary based on insufficient identification may be remedied by submitting valid national or EU identification documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal formation notice (Annonce légale)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish in the authorized JAL a notice stating the corporate name, form (SARL), amount of share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, surname and address of the Gérant, and the RCS reference where applicable. Obtain the attestation de parution. The publication must occur before or accompany the filing of the formation dossier with the Guichet unique.
required_dossiers: Text of the annonce légale conforming to Article R.210-3 of the Code de commerce
Attestation de parution issued by the JAL
Proof of payment of the publication fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL rejects the notice for non-conformity, reword the text in accordance with Article R.210-3 and republish; ensure the attestation de parution carries the correct publication date, as this date is quoted in the RCS filing and cannot be back-dated.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the incorporation dossier through the INPI Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) acting on behalf of the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Guichet unique portal and complete the unified Déclaration de création d'entreprise. Attach the certified Statutes, the attestation de parution, the attestation de dépôt des fonds, identity documents, the beneficial-owner declaration, and the mandatory sworn declarations. Sign electronically and pay the statutory registration fee online. Track the dossier with the portal-generated reference number; the Greffe processes the file after the INPI transmission.
required_dossiers: Statuts (signed, dated, paginated, and with all annexes)
Attestation de parution in the JAL
Attestation de dépôt des fonds / capital deposit certificate
Identity document of the Gérant and of each associate
Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs
Déclaration sur l'honneur de non-condamnation
Power of attorney where filing is made through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Guichet unique flags incompleteness, a régularisation request is issued through the portal and the filing clock is suspended; the filer must upload the missing document within 15 days. If the Greffe rejects the application, the filer may lodge a motion before the presiding judge of the tribunal judiciaire (Article R.123-6-1 of the Code de commerce) within 15 days of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration and issuance of K-bis, SIREN, SIRET, APE code and intra-community VAT number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of the registered office (Registre du commerce et des sociétés).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Greffe verifies the legality and completeness of the dossier, fixes the date of immatriculation, and enters the SARL in the RCS. Upon registration, INSEE issues the SIREN, SIRET and APE code; the tax authority issues the EU VAT identification number under Article 286-I of the CGI where the company carries on taxable activity. Download the K-bis from the official commercial-register repository and verify all data.
required_dossiers: Complete dossier transmitted at step 3
Proof of payment of the Greffe registration fee
Justification of the registered-office address (lease, bail commercial, or title documents)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Greffe exceeds the statutory processing period (2 working days after receipt of a complete dossier under R.123-5 of the Code de commerce), the applicant may request acceleration through the Guichet unique escalation channel or petition the President of the court; any refusal of registration is appealable within 15 days before the unified court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration notifications and opening of the operating bank account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caisse URSSAF, business tax center (Service des impôts des entreprises), and the local municipal administration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Receive the definitive K-bis and open the operating bank account in the company's name. Verify that the Guichet unique automatically notified the URSSAF, the tax center, and INSEE. Confirm receipt of the URSSAF registration number and the date of commencement of the URSSAF employer/individual contribution obligations. Keep the K-bis, SIRET, and VAT certificates on file for the DSP2 payment-rail onboarding of PayPal and Stripe.
required_dossiers: Definitive K-bis certificate
Bank account opening documentation
Proof of registered-office occupation (lease or ownership document)
VAT registration certificate once issued
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any automatic notification to URSSAF or the tax center fails, manually file the corresponding déclaration de début d'activité in the respective online portals (gestion.urssaf.fr and impots.gouv.fr) within 15 days, referencing the SIREN; any delay may be cured by a late-filing notice accompanied by proof of the RCS registration date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREETS (Direction régionale de l'économie, de l'emploi, du travail et des solidarités) for workplace safety and employment controls; DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement) for environmental regulation; SDIS (Service départemental d'incendie et de secours) for fire safety inspection; CARSAT for occupational risk prevention.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No specific manufacturing licence is required for the carbon-fiber milling and brushless-motor integration of FPV racing drones under French law; however, the SARL must hold its RCS K-bis, comply with the CE-marking and Radio Equipment Directive 2014/53/EU for the drone controllers, and ensure conformity of the placed products; the DGAC operator registration under Regulation (EU) 2019/947 applies to the drone operator/user, not to the manufacturer, unless the SARL itself operates drones for testing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement), under the Ministry of Ecological Transition; municipal mairie for land-use and public-sewer discharge permits.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Non-ICPE below threshold: the carbon-fiber milling and motor-integration workshop is not subject to a full environmental authorization; the ICPE 'déclaration' regime (rubrique 2661, treatment of polymers) applies only if the installed capacity processes 10 tonnes or more of polymers per day. A simple administrative file with the land-use conformity notice and, where applicable, a declaration of existing activity to be filed at the DREAL suffices. Full EIA is not triggered at this project scale.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Where the workshop discharges into the public sewer, a discharge authorization under Article L.1331-10 of the Code général des collectivités territoriales is required; wastewater pH must be between 5.5 and 9.5, and suspended solids below 600 mg/L prior to municipal pre-treatment limits. Particulate emissions from carbon-fiber milling must remain below the general ICPE dust standard of 40 mg/Nm³ for dry mechanical treatment processes; volatile organic compound emissions from resin handling must comply with Directive 2010/75/EU and, for non-ICPE sites, with the Code du travail 8-hour exposure limits of 3 mg/m³ for formaldehyde-equivalent emissions; carbon-fiber dust and composite offcuts are tracked as hazardous waste through a bordereau de suivi de déchets (BSD) with sealed waste storage and disposal only at registered treatment facilities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the commission de sécurité of the mairie and the SDIS for the workshop: verified fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and fire-resistance of production areas; a structural load inspection confirming floor capacity for milling machines; an electrical installation conformity check (bilan de sécurité électrique) required before the machines are energized; occupational clearance by the occupational health service (médecin du travail) verifying the aptitude of employees, noise-level compliance below 80 dB(A) daily exposure with mandatory hearing protection, and the provision of local exhaust ventilation for carbon-fiber dust with high-efficiency particulate filters.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Economy and Finance; operational portals: impots.gouv.fr, Espace Professionnel (professionnels.impots.gouv.fr), and the single company-formation portal formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique under the INPI). Customs and excise competence lies with the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) at douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL is incorporated via the Guichet Unique, triggering automatic INSEE assignment of the SIREN (national corporate TIN), its SIRET establishment code and the company tax file at the territorial SIE; the DGFiP subsequently issues the intra-Community VAT identification number for EU cross-border transactions. For a non-established foreign vendor, VAT registration is made by direct application to the competent SIE using Cerfa form 3310-CA, appointment of a French fiscal representative where statute so requires (CGI art. 289 A) for non-EU applicants, and evidence of the foreign seat and effective management; the SIE then enters the entity and allocates the FR-prefixed VAT number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no check-the-box system; classification follows the legal form, so a standard SARL takes company personality and is by default taxed at entity level to corporate income tax (IS, CGI art. 206-1). Express statutory elections do exist: (i) a qualifying family SARL may irrevocably opt into the transparent societe de personnes income-tax regime (CGI art. 239 bis AA); (ii) a 95-per-cent parent may opt into French tax consolidation under CGI art. 223 A; (iii) a VAT-group election is available for the status of a single taxable person (CGI art. 256 C); (iv) hybrid-mismatch alignment under ATAD implementation requires symmetric income classification with counterpart jurisdictions. Elections are formally filed with the SIE and are generally irrevocable or subject to statutory lock-in periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) acts as the central bank, the balance-of-payments statistical authority and the operator of the French TARGET2/T2 euro RTGS settlement infrastructure. The Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) is the prudential supervisor for French credit institutions, payment institutions and electronic-money institutions. The Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) administers the foreign-investment screening regime (IEF - investissements étrangers en France) under Articles L.151-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier, CMF), while EU capital-movement, sanctions and anti-money-laundering rules are applied at national level by French banks under CMF Articles L.561-1 et seq. and the AMLD5 framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in France. There are no French exchange controls on current-account or capital-account operations (TFEU Articles 63-66; CMF Articles L.151-1 to L.165-2). The SARL may freely denominate contracts in EUR, USD, RMB or any other currency, convert funds without central-bank authorization, and remit dividends, interest, service fees or loan repayments to non-resident shareholders without FX licensing. Profit remittance hurdles are purely fiscal and documentary: distributions are subject to a 25% French withholding tax on dividends paid to non-French tax residents (Article 119 bis 2 of the French General Tax Code), which is reduced to 10% where the Chinese parent company holds directly at least 25% of the SARL's capital (and to 15% in other cases) under the France-China Double Tax Treaty of 26 November 2013, provided the beneficial-owner form RF1 procedure and a tax-residence certificate are submitted. Physical cash transport within the EU is unrestricted but a customs declaration is mandatory for cash movements of EUR 10,000 or more under Regulation (EC) No 1889/2005. No French treasury or central-bank permit is required for any bank transfer in connection with capital injections, trade settlements or profit repatriation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The French regulatory framework imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no repatriation timeline and no conversion ratio for foreign-currency export receipts. The SARL may retain export revenue indefinitely in foreign-currency accounts and convert it at market rates at its commercial discretion. The only compliance obligations are statistical: French banks report the SARL's cross-border financial transactions to the Banque de France balance-of-payments (BOP) office, and the SARL must cooperate in direct-investment BOP declarations whenever annual direct-investment flows between residents and non-residents exceed EUR 15 million or a direct-investment relationship is established or terminated. Dual-use export screening under EU Regulation 2021/821 applies only to drone hardware meeting specific control parameters; standard consumer FPV racing drones (ISIC 3240, EU class C0-C2 under Regulation (EU) 2019/947) do not trigger control-list classification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (compte de dépôt professionnel); pre-incorporation Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) with attestation de dépôt des fonds for the SARL capital deposit
Operational Account; pre-incorporation Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué) with deposit certificate; FX and trade-finance desk available

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. via LCL (Crédit Lyonnais) or regional Caisse Régionale de Crédit Agricole
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; local branch relationship model with integrated SEPA and SWIFT clearing

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Groupe BPCE (Banque Populaire or Caisse d'Épargne)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account; specialized professional banking unit and export finance desk
Operational Account; full corporate banking and documentary credit services (LC, guarantees)
Operational Account only; limited trade-finance and FX-hedging product range

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual tax return filing including income statement and balance sheet
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Authority (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques - DGFiP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15th day of the third month following the end of the fiscal year (e.g., April 15 for a calendar year fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 40 euros per month of delay, capped at one year; prolonged non-filing may trigger administrative sanctions including potential company strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts with the commercial register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Court Registry (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the same timeframe as the tax return filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines and risk of company dissolution for non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership register annual confirmation and shareholding transfer declarations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Authority (DGFiP) or commercial registry upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually or upon any change in ownership or control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines for failure to maintain accurate beneficial ownership information

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SARL exceeds two of the following: turnover exceeding 800000 EUR, balance sheet total exceeding 400000 EUR, or employing 50 or more persons

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual review and update of the beneficial ownership register; filing of declarations for any shareholding transfers or capital changes

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard; 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 taxable profit for qualifying SMEs
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate; R&D tax credit (Crédit d'impôt recherche) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses; innovation tax credit (Crédit d'impôt innovation) 20% of eligible innovation costs up to €400k; young innovative company (JEI) partial exemption up to 100% for first 3 years? Actually JEI: total exemption of IS for first 3 profitable years, 50% for next 2 years — but that's for qualifying innovative SMEs. Given drone manufacturing with R&D, JEI may apply.
